attempted_claim: Let Lambda be a maximal Thurston-Bennequin Legendrian representative of the torus knot T(p,q) with p<0, q>=6 even and q congruent to 2 mod 4 (smallest case T(-7,6), with max-tb front as in Figure 17 of Chen-Crider-Phillips-Reinoso-Sabloff-Yao). Does Lambda admit a decomposable exact non-orientable Lagrangian filling L in (B^4, omega_0)? The question of existence of any (not necessarily decomposable) exact non-orientable filling is kept as a separate, strictly stronger question.
decisive_failure: originality: EMERGENT_FINDING route verified as genuine: arose from admitted family target T(p,q) q=2 mod 4 via ruling-rigidity+signature route in target_exit, so absence from topic.json is not adverse. CCPRSY indeed leaves q=2 mod 4 open (Thm 1.5 covers only q odd and 4|q; rlk2=0; Conj 6.3 unproven). However Binns-Kang-Simone-Truol arXiv:2109.09187 Thm 1.7(b)+Lemma 2.9+Sec 3.4 proves stronger smooth fact gamma4(T(6,7)) in {2,3} via Alexander stretch 3, i.e. no smooth Mobius (any e) for the mirror of T(-7,6). A decomposable exact Lagrangian Mobius with e=42 is a smooth Mobius, so the headline is substantively implied as a corollary of a known stronger theorem. Fairchild et al restates the same bound. Prior need not state Lagrangian wording verbatim.
